notes: Only the cover and step pages (2 pages) were supplied; the inventory pages with Element IDs and exact piece counts were not visible, so piece types and colours are best-fit matches from the step pictures and the catalogue.
Exact stud positions and stacking order are approximated from the small step images. Each stud / anti-stud port is now used by only one join; which specific stud a piece sits on is an assumption.
Wheels use lego-614126 (pin-hole) so they fit the wheel-holder pins; this fixes the earlier pin/axle-hole mismatch.

The propeller is now mounted on an axle (b22) that goes through a round plate with axle hole (b23) on the nose; this replaces the earlier invalid stud/axle-hole join. The axle and nose plate are assumptions, since the pictures show only the propeller at the nose.
Step 7 shows a sub-assembly (two black plates joined, then a black slope added); modelled as b12, b13 and b14 stacked on the black body plate.
Step 8-9 plates (b15-b18) were moved onto the black body plate b10, which is where they appear in the pictures, to avoid reusing b1's studs.
Page 1 also shows other models (5866 helicopter, 5867 car, 5891 house); they are other sets' models and not part of the 7808 booklet, so they were not built.
